description: Driving range text surface shown for the SOC (battery pure-electric) range segment. diRangeSurfaceDraw/SetData renders the range text when the resident card is CARD_RANGE and the SOC range show flag (socRangeShow) is non-zero; a positive SOC range-to-empty value is provided so the SOC range segment is rendered.

mem.desc: SOC range segment show flag enabled
positive SOC (battery) range-to-empty value for rendering
